state.spec: Rewrite packages/flow/src/flow/builder/app.py so BuilderApp is a REAL, usable TUI (currently it renders flat text, has no quit, and collapses to empty at width<=0). Satisfy the contract in packages/flow/tests/test_builder_app.py EXACTLY. Requirements: (1) BuilderApp keeps its existing API: __init__(self, model, path), the `model` property, handle_input(event)->bool, render(width)->list[str], the normal/prompt/edge modes, and helpers. (2) NEW: a public settable attribute `on_quit: Callable[[], None] | None = None` (init to None). In normal mode, pressing 'q' calls self.on_quit() if it is not None, and returns True (consumed). (3) render(width) must NEVER collapse to all-empty lines: guard width — use an effective width of max(width, 40) internally for fitting/padding so that even width=0 or negative yields visible content (the pty passes width=0 sometimes). Every returned line list is non-empty and at least one line has non-whitespace content. (4) render(width) is a VERTICAL SECTIONED layout, NOT a flat dump and NOT a duplicated node list: a header/title line (e.g. 'flow builder — <name>'), a horizontal rule (a line of '-' fitted to width) separating sections, a NODES section listing each node id with a leading marker ('> ' for the selected node, '* ' for the edge-source in edge mode, '  ' otherwise) and its [type], a horizontal rule, a GRAPH section rendering flow.graph.to_ascii(model.wf) (this is the ONLY place the topology is shown — do NOT also inline a second node list, so a node id appears at most twice total across the whole render), a horizontal rule, and a STATUS footer line showing 'status: valid' or the validation error, plus a 'mode: <mode>' line and a short keybind hint line (a s j k d p e w q). (5) run(path)->None must: build the app, create a TUI, add the app as a child, set focus, wire app.on_quit = tui.stop (so 'q' exits), call tui.start() in try/finally with tui.stop() in finally. Mark run() with `# pragma: no cover`. (6) Keep imports clean; from tui.tui import TUI, Component; from tui.keys import KeyEvent. Full type annotations (mypy --strict), ruff-clean line-length 120. The whole point: after this, `xdog-flow build file.svg` shows a sectioned UI in a real terminal AND 'q' exits.
